baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَقْضِهِم مِّيثَاقَهُمْ, قُلُوبَهُمْ قَاسِيَةً, and يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ عَن مَّوَاضِعِهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah presents one structural cascade: an assured bond is dismantled, the receptive interior becomes hard and barren, and verbal units are then tilted away from their assigned locations. Breach, hardening, and distortion are successive failures of relational and semantic placement rather than an unconnected list of faults.

activation_trace.role: Undoing a tightly made thing supplies the initiating structural failure: the covenant is dismantled rather than merely disobeyed.
Firm fastening makes the covenant a load-bearing bond whose loss can reorganize everything attached to it.
Hard, dry, non-growing material turns the heart's condition into failed receptivity rather than only an affective lack of sympathy.
Inclining something away from its direction supplies the active rerouting operation applied to the words.
A settled or assigned place supplies the semantic topology that the rerouting violates.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists covenant-breaking, hard hearts, and textual alteration as several offenses.
changed_reading.after: The ayah traces a single topology of failure: unfastening the bond hardens its receiving core and culminates in moving signs out of the relations that let them function.

baseline_models.mechanism: Forgetting can be active leaving, while حظ is an apportioned due and تذكير is a supplied reminder. The phrase therefore allows a selective-performance model: a covenantal allocation was received but a portion was left unattended, with partial omission capable of deforming the whole.

activation_trace.role: Leaving and neglect, rather than involuntary memory loss alone, supplies the agency in the omission.
An allotted share makes the omitted material a due portion within a distributed whole.
A reminder that makes something present supplies the delivered content from which the share was left.
The confirmed pact makes the neglected share a covenantal obligation rather than miscellaneous information.

changed_reading.before: They accidentally failed to remember part of an earlier teaching.
changed_reading.after: They left an apportioned covenantal due unenacted; the defect is selective abandonment inside a received whole, not merely a lapse of recall.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَلَا تَزَالُ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى خَائِنَةٍ مِّنْهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ... فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَاصْفَحْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Continuous disclosure, a stated minority exception, and two mercy commands form a disciplined sequence. The addressee remains able to uncover particular failures of fidelity, avoids converting them into a totalizing judgment, then waives punishment and turns away without recrimination. إحسان makes this informed restraint an active good rather than passive inattention.

activation_trace.role: The idiom of continuing action makes detection recurrent rather than a single discovery.
Looking into and uncovering an affair supplies evidence-bearing awareness of concealed conduct.
Deficient fidelity identifies the discovered object as a concrete breach of trust.
The small exception blocks the recurring breaches from becoming an undifferentiated verdict on every member.
Waiving punishment supplies the first deliberate response after accurate detection.
Beautifully turning away from the offense supplies non-recriminatory closure rather than denial.
Doing good and exceeding bare justice makes mercy a constructive practice.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness means ceasing to notice or minimizing betrayal.
changed_reading.after: The ayah joins recurrent, discriminating awareness to chosen non-retaliation: discover the specific breach, preserve the exception, then waive and close beautifully.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns the baseline bond into a maintained covenantal system. Completion without deficit and tied ends define integrity; twelve guarantor-observers distribute oversight; and the good loan figures performance as an outlay entering a return relation. نَقْض in the focus can thus name failure of a network of offices, practices, and reciprocities, not only one broken promise.

activation_trace.role: Dismantling a made structure remains the focus operation to be explained.
The confirmed pact anchors every contextual maintenance image back in the focus covenant.
Completion without shortage supplies the positive integrity condition opposed by breach and neglected share.
Tying ends together materializes contracts as joined components that require continued fastening.
A naqib as group representative and guarantor supplies distributed human points of covenant maintenance.
Cutting out wealth or work for a returning recompense adds reciprocal flow to the maintained bond.

structural_cues: 5:1 opens with fulfillment of contracts, while 5:12 takes the covenant, appoints twelve naqibs, and specifies recurring performances before 5:13 names its breach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion, tied ends, guarantor-representatives, and reciprocal outlay; I infer that covenant integrity is distributed maintenance across roles and repeated acts. A live alternative is that these images only intensify solemnity without implying an institutional system.

changed_reading.before: Their breach is an isolated failure to keep a solemn promise.
changed_reading.after: Their breach dismantles a distributed maintenance system whose integrity depends on complete performance, accountable representatives, and continuing reciprocal acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered purification sequence assigns different operations to specified bodily loci and repeats face and hands under an alternate material condition. This sharpens مَوَاضِع into operational slots: distortion can preserve recognizable verbal material while rerouting it to a location, relation, or procedure where it no longer performs correctly.

activation_trace.role: Directional deviation supplies the rerouting rather than requiring deletion of the words.
Meaning-bearing verbal units are the items whose functional relations are altered.
A prescribed place anchors the focus's placement-sensitive semantics.
Washing removes impurity through one specified operation, supplying one procedure in the ordered map.
The face as a defined bodily surface supplies a repeated locus whose identity persists across procedures.
Passing the hand and removing a trace supplies a second operation whose proper locus matters.

structural_cues: 5:6 orders washing and wiping across face, hands, head, and feet with explicit endpoints, then reassigns face and hands under dry ablution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct operations, repeated body loci, and boundaries; I infer a placement-sensitive procedural analogy for the focus's words and positions. The live alternative is that 5:6 only heightens spatial precision and does not imply procedural transposition.

changed_reading.before: They alter the wording or meaning in a general way.
changed_reading.after: They can leave words recognizable yet route them into the wrong interpretive or operational slot, as a correct act applied to the wrong locus ceases to function as prescribed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Witnessing, knowledge of inner reality, and naqib-style investigation sharpen تَطَّلِعُ into covenantal oversight. The recurring discoveries are evidence events within an accountability structure, while إِلَّا قَلِيلًا prohibits converting pattern recognition into indiscriminate suspicion. Pardon follows bounded ascertainment and does not abolish it.

activation_trace.role: A reconnaissance party that discovers an adversary supplies the focus's active, repeated fact-finding posture.
The object of oversight is a specific deficit of fidelity, not group identity.
The explicit minority exception imposes a discrimination constraint on the oversight model.
Presence with observation supplies public evidence rather than rumor as the mode of accountability.
Knowledge of the interior of an affair sharpens the distinction between surface suspicion and informed judgment.
Searching into interiors and reports supplies an oversight function adjacent to the covenant's establishment.

structural_cues: 5:7 closes covenant remembrance with knowledge of what is within breasts; 5:8 requires witnessing in justice; 5:12 places naqibs beside the covenant; 5:13 preserves an explicit exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witness, inward knowledge, investigative leadership, recurring disclosure, and an exception; I infer a bounded evidentiary oversight regime. A live alternative is that تَطَّلِعُ describes ordinary personal encounters rather than a formal accountability function.

changed_reading.before: The addressee should expect permanent treachery from the group and then forgive it.
changed_reading.after: The addressee should keep ascertaining particular covenant failures through evidence, protect the exceptional few from collective suspicion, and practice mercy after rather than instead of discernment.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:14 repeats the focus's neglected-share sequence, then carries it into an activated relation of enmity and aversion; 5:15 immediately joins disclosure of hidden material to passing over much. Together they recast the focus's عفو and صفح as selective breach processing: truth is not suppressed, but not every discovered wrong is converted into a durable social feedback loop.

activation_trace.role: Waiving punishment anchors the alternative breach response in the focus command.
Turning away beautifully supplies closure that does not keep retransmitting the offense.
The repeated leaving of remembered material establishes the exact neighboring failure pattern.
The repeated allotted share makes the parallel with the focus precise rather than merely thematic.
The repeated reminder completes the neighboring focus-pattern before its different social consequence unfolds.
Incitement that sets something persistently upon another supplies the activation arrow into hostility.
A relation standing between parties supplies the social channel through which activated hostility persists.
Aversive repulsion names the durable affective product of the escalation path.
Concealed material supplies what can be truthfully disclosed without requiring exhaustive prosecution.
Passing over much while much is clarified demonstrates selective forbearance operating alongside disclosure.

structural_cues: 5:14 repeats نَسُوا حَظًّا مِّمَّا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ and then extends enmity and hatred until the day of resurrection.
5:15 pairs clarification of much that was hidden with passing over much, so exposure and forbearance coexist.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact repeated failure followed by long-lived hostility, then adjacent selective disclosure and passing over; I infer two contrasting ways of processing breach, with the focus command interrupting escalation. A live alternative is that the adjacent sequences primarily distinguish communities and are not intended as a direct policy contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus tells the addressee to pardon individuals despite repeated betrayal.
changed_reading.after: The focus prescribes a controlled anti-escalation practice: expose what must be known, waive much without falsifying it, and refuse to turn each breach into a self-perpetuating relation of hatred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated warning that hatred must not drive transgression or injustice places the focus's pardon inside a prior discipline of fair placement. إحسان then operates as a voluntary surplus beyond justice, not as the erasure of standards. Mercy prevents resentment from becoming another form of تحريف while retaining truthful discrimination.

activation_trace.role: Beautiful non-recrimination supplies the merciful act whose relation to justice is being clarified.
Beneficent action and increase beyond bare justice supply the focus's positive ethical surplus.
Hatred and enmity supply the pressure that can bend response away from its proper limit.
The repeated hatred cue confirms that affective bias, not only the opponent's conduct, is under regulation.
Equity supplies the public standard that precedes any merciful surplus.
Just judgment and conduct supply the non-negotiable baseline from which ihsan can exceed rather than deviate.

structural_cues: 5:2 and 5:8 repeat the syntax that hostility must not cause a wrongful response; 5:13 answers discovered breach with pardon and closes by naming those who do ihsan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bias-control, equity, justice, pardon, and ihsan; I infer an order in which justice fixes the baseline and mercy adds a freely chosen surplus. A live alternative is that the particular pardon relinquishes personal claims without specifying how public adjudication continues.

changed_reading.before: Pardon replaces judgment and asks the addressee simply to overlook the offense.
changed_reading.after: Pardon is justice-plus: first refuse hatred's distortion and preserve equitable judgment, then add non-recrimination and beneficence beyond what strict justice demands.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence orders entry, warns against turning back, records refusal at the door, then ends in sitting and wandering. Because قلب names both the focus's interior and the contextual reversal, hardening can be read dynamically as a directional lock: the inner turning faculty fixes itself toward retreat, and the same orientation failure appears when words are moved from their places.

activation_trace.role: The heart as understanding and inner orientation anchors the directional model in the focus.
Loss of inner softness supplies the fixation that prevents responsive turning.
Deviation from direction links inner fixation to the focus's displaced speech.
Returning something toward its prior place supplies the warned-against backward motion.
Presenting the back and turning away makes refusal a bodily orientation rather than only a verbal no.
Turning a thing from one face to another activates the reversal potential latent in the focus's قلب.
The door supplies the concrete threshold at which correct orientation would become entry.
Sitting out an action supplies the immobilized endpoint of backward orientation.

structural_cues: 5:21 commands entry and forbids turning on the backs; 5:23 locates decision at the door; 5:24 declares sitting; branchless ت ي ه at 5:26 marks wandering after refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entry, backward turning, the قلب root in a reversal verb, a threshold, inaction, and eventual wandering; I infer that focus-heart hardening is a fixed orientation that generates semantic and practical misdirection. A live alternative is that the later episode echoes communal failure without explaining the focus's inner causality.

changed_reading.before: Hard hearts are a static emotional condition that accompanies textual distortion.
changed_reading.after: Hardening fixes the inner turning faculty toward retreat: it cannot reorient at the threshold, so action stalls, words lose their proper direction, and movement degenerates into wandering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates bodily branches of كلم and حرف beneath an ordinary reading about words and alteration. It remains anchored because both roots and the later erasure/page roots occur in the focus, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for the effects of distortion, not claim that الْكَلِمَ lexically means wounds here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ عَن مَّوَاضِعِهِ ... فَاعْفُ ... وَاصْفَحْ.

activation_trace.role: A probe that measures a wound turns alteration into an exploratory image of intervention in damaged tissue.
A bodily wound supplies the damaged medium on which displaced discourse leaves effects.
Erasure of a trace supplies healing that does not require denying that an injury occurred.
Turning and inspecting pages supplies a shift from repeatedly probing the wound to moving through the record.

changed_reading.before: Textual distortion only changes propositions or interpretations.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, displaced speech wounds the shared communicative body; pardon erases the retaliatory trace and turns the page without pretending the wound was absent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This ecological reading is surprising because it crosses from hard-heartedness and pardon into soil, seed, and growth branches. It remains anchored in قاسية, عفو, يحب, and محسنين and is contextually activated by growth in 5:12; downstream prose should label it a regenerative analogy, not a lexical replacement for pardon.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُلُوبَهُمْ قَاسِيَةً ... فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ ... إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ.

activation_trace.role: Dry, hard ground that does not grow supplies the damaged ecological state of the receiving interior.
Growth and increase when something is left supplies a regenerative consequence for restrained punishment.
A seed that germinates supplies the small latent capacity toward which regenerative restraint is directed.
Beneficent action supplies cultivation rather than mere non-interference.
Growth and increase in the covenant-performance context activate the possibility that mercy aims at renewed fruitfulness.

changed_reading.before: Pardon merely cancels a deserved penalty.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified ecological model, pardon leaves regenerative space around a hardened interior so that latent seed can grow into active ihsan.

strongest_changes: The focus became a topology of covenant failure: an unfastened bond hardens its receiving core and displaces verbal units from the relations that let them function.
The exact forgotten-share repetition in 5:14, followed by enduring hostility, and the disclosure-plus-passing-over pattern in 5:15 recast pardon as selective anti-escalation rather than ignorance.
Witness, inward knowledge, naqib investigation, and the explicit minority exception turned recurring discovery into bounded evidentiary oversight rather than collective suspicion.
The entry, reversal, door, sitting, and wandering sequence in 5:21-26 activated heart-hardening as a directional lock rather than a static emotion.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly transformed static moral nouns into mechanisms: covenant became maintained structure, word-position became procedural topology, mercy became a truth-preserving interruption of social escalation, and قلب linked inner state to bodily reversal.
remaining_uncertainties: The purification sequence may only sharpen spatial precision rather than authorize a full procedural analogy for word placement.
The directional reading from 5:21-26 may be a strong pericope echo without being the focus's intended account of inner hardening.
The wound and regenerative-fallow models should remain explicitly qualified analogies unless downstream evidence independently strengthens them.
